9: ## Context
10: 
11: Story `P2-D` (`p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules`) delivers the REST API, domain services, deterministic recipe expression compiler, in-memory sandbox dry-run engine, `Asia/Manila` cron schedule validator, and cross-context read/cutover ports for the `com.example.app.configuration` bounded context inside `app/backend/`. Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-d-configuration-definitions-recipes-schedules.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/configuration-management.md`, `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md`), `ADR 0002` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0002-openapi-v1-contract-conventions.md`), `ADR 0004` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0004-configuration-immutability-and-mvp-seeding.md`), `ADR 0005` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0005-execution-and-governance-persistence-schema.md`), and `ADR 0008` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0008-iam-rbac-sod-and-view-as.md`) establish six non-trivial architectural and security constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **Seeded MVP Funding Cost Summary Definitions, Maker-Checker Staging, Optimistic Concurrency, and MVP `UPLOAD_ONLY` Guardrail (`AC-1`, `AC-2`, `AC-6`, `AC-8`):**
14:    - `GET /api/v1/definitions` (`listReportDefinitions`) must apply offset pagination (`page >= 1`, `limit` `1..100`, default `20`) and return the five seeded MVP Funding Cost Summary definitions (`FUNDING_COST_CASHOUT_O
<truncated 4293 bytes>
.64` chars matching `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`).
25:      - `effectiveAt`: future top-of-hour in `Asia/Manila`.
26:    - Computes the canonical 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 checksum (`checksum_sha256`) over the normalized canonical JSON payload (`inputSchemaJson`, `outputSchemaJson`, `transformationRulesJson`, `lookupBindingsJson`), allocates `version_number = COALESCE(MAX(version_number), 0) + 1` for `report_definition_id`, inserts an immutable `recipe_versions` row with `lifecycle_status = "PENDING_PUBLISH"`, creates a `PENDING_APPROVAL` governance ticket (`ticket_type = "RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH"`, `target_definition_id = id`, `target_recipe_version_id = recipe.id`), records `CONFIG_RECIPE_VERSION_CREATED` in `audit_log_entries`, and returns `HTTP 201 Created`.
27: 
28: 3. **Deterministic In-Memory Sandbox Dry-Run (`POST /api/v1/recipes/dry-run`) (`AC-4`, `AC-8`):**
29:    - `POST /api/v1/recipes/dry-run` (`executeRecipeDryRun`) validates `RecipeDryRunRequest` (`recipeVersionId` UUID, `sampleCsvRows` containing `1..100` non-empty strings up to `4096` characters each, `additionalProperties: false`), loads the target `recipe_versions` row (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` if `recipeVersionId` does not exist), and evaluates the recipe in memory without writing or mutating any persistent database rows or external I/O (`p95 <= 600 ms`).
30:    - Parses `sampleCsvRows` (accepting either a header row matching `inputSchemaJson.columns` followed by data rows, or positional CSV data rows mapped to `inputSchemaJson.columns`), validates column count and numeric/required values per row, evaluates `transformationRulesJson.expressions` deterministically (including `ROUND(gross_amount * commission_rate, 2)` and channel/output assignments), and collects `previewRows` (for valid rows) and human-readable row-indexed `exceptions` (for malformed CSV column count, non-numeric operands, division by zero, or filter mismatches), returning `HTTP 200 OK` (`RecipeDryRunResponse` with `validOutputRows`, `exceptionRows`, `previewRows`, `exceptions`).

90: - `RBAC` — Enforces explicit operation-to-permission guards (`CONFIG_DEFINITIONS_READ`, `CONFIG_DEFINITIONS_WRITE`, `CONFIG_RECIPES_READ`, `CONFIG_RECIPES_WRITE`, `CONFIG_SCHEDULES_READ`, `CONFIG_SCHEDULES_WRITE`) across all configuration endpoints and blocks all mutating calls under an active `View-As` session overlay (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`) (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, §11; VAPT F8).
91: - `auth` — Requires an active fail-closed Redis-backed session (`FailClosedRedisSessionFilter`) on every configuration route (`401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED` when missing/expired) (`security-baseline.mdc` §1; VAPT F4).
92: - `any {id} path` — Exposes `GET /api/v1/definitions/{id}`, `PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/definitions/{id}/recipes`, `POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/recipes`, `GET /api/v1/recipes/{id}`, `GET /api/v1/schedules/{id}`, and `PUT /api/v1/schedules/{id}` requiring strict UUID validation, `If-Match` optimistic concurrency control (`HTTP 412` / `HTTP 409`), and `Idempotency-Key` enforcement on `POST` creations (`security-baseline.mdc` §2, §5; VAPT F8, F9).
93: - **Sensitive actions (for Design step-up / dual-control evaluation)**: Creating or updating a report definition (`POST /api/v1/definitions`, `PUT /api/v1/definitions/{id}`), publishing a new JSON transformation recipe version (`POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/recipes`), and enabling or modifying an automated `Asia/Manila` run schedule (`PUT /api/v1/schedules/{id}`)—each staged behind a mandatory maker-checker `PENDING_APPROVAL` governance ticket (`REPORT_DEFINITION_CREATE`, `REPORT_DEFINITION_CHANGE`, `RECIPE_VERSION_PUBLISH`, `SCHEDULE_CHANGE`), mandatory `warningAcknowledged = true` on schedule updates, top-of-hour future `effectiveAt` validation, and immutable audit logging (`audit_log_entries`).
94: 
95: ## Regulations
96: 
97: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Change Management Controls)**: Mandates formal maker-checker dual control over financial report definitions, commission calculation formulas (`recipe_versions` with SHA-256 integrity checksums), and automated pipeline schedules (`schedule_configs`), plus 13-month retention of superseded recipe versions for regulatory auditability and run reproducibility.
98: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires least-privilege access control and tamper-evident audit trails (`audit_log_entries`) recording the actor and correlation ID for every configuration and recipe change affecting financial reporting pipelines.
99: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §6, §11, §12 & VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10)**: Requires fail-closed route permission checks, `View-As` mutation blocking (`VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`), strict `additionalProperties: false` DTO validation, deterministic non-Turing-complete JSON recipe expression validation (preventing expression/script injection in `transformationRulesJson` and `POST /api/v1/recipes/dry-run`), `Asia/Manila` top-of-hour `effectiveAt` enforcement, mandatory cron warning acknowledgment (`warningAcknowledged = true`), and `Encode.forJava()` audit log sanitization.
